components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action across the site (Start Application, Submit, Continue).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; background: #159447; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(21,148,71,0.3); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0d7a38; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(21,148,71,0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0a6330; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(21,148,71,0.4); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a6330; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions alongside a primary CTA (Track Application, See How It Works).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; background: #ffffff; color: #159447; border: 1.5px solid #159447; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eaf6ee; border-color: #0d7a38; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #d8f3e5; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #159447; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Interactive Card
components.description: Service/state selection cards, step summary cards — the primary content container.
components.html:
Learner's Licence

Apply for your first learner's permit with guided steps.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); border: 1px solid #edf2f7; padding: 24px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 250ms ease, box-shadow 250ms ease, border-color 250ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-color: rgba(21,148,71,0.4); } .ds-card:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #18232d; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 1rem; color: #5b6470; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field used throughout the application wizard.
components.css: .ds-field { margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-label { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #2d3748; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-required { color: #e53e3e; margin-left: 4px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1.5px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; color: #18232d; background: #ffffff; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; min-height: 44px; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #159447; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(21,148,71,0.1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8896a6; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Application status indicators (Submitted, Under Review, Completed).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-badge-success { background: #eaf6ee; color: #159447; } .ds-badge-warning { background: #fef9e7; color: #92610e; } .ds-badge-error { background: #fed7d7; color: #e53e3e; } .ds-badge-info { background: #ebf8ff; color: #3182ce; }

components.name: Disclaimer Bar
components.description: Signature trust component: the non-government notice shown above the header on every page.
components.html: ⓘ This is not an official Government portal. We assist you with the driving licence application process.
components.css: .ds-disclaimer { background: #fef9e7; color: #92610e; font-size: 0.75rem; text-align: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0e6c0; }

narrative.overview:
The system reads like the calm, competent window at a well-run government office — official-adjacent confidence without cold bureaucracy. A citizen arrives unsure of a confusing process; the interface's job is to feel like a person behind glass who knows exactly what to do next, hands over one thing at a time, and never hides a fee or a form field. The palette carries this directly: an official green paired with a warm, paper-toned off-white — trustworthy rather than clinical, civic rather than corporate.

Density stays moderate: generous section padding on marketing-mode surfaces, tighter form rhythm where the citizen is doing task work. Every interactive surface has a small, tactile lift — a card or button visibly responds to touch, the way a good physical counter clerk visibly acknowledges you.
keyCharacteristics: Official-but-warm green + paper-white, never stark white or corporate blue
Cards and buttons lift on hover/press — tactile, responsive, alive
Generous whitespace in Persuade sections, tighter rhythm in Operate/form sections
Rounded-but-restrained geometry (6–20px), never sharp, never pill-everything
Devanagari/Gujarati-aware type rhythm (looser line-height, more vertical breathing room on non-Latin scripts)

rules.name: The Trust-Never-Recolors Rule
rules.body: The disclaimer bar and its warning color are never restyled toward brand green or hidden behind a lower-contrast treatment — the 'not a government portal' notice must always read as a warning, not a footnote.

rules.name: The Script-Height Rule
rules.body: Devanagari and Gujarati headings get looser line-height (1.45 vs 1.3) and small top/bottom padding to prevent matra and conjunct clipping.

rules.name: The Press-Response Rule
rules.body: Every clickable card or button visibly responds on press (translateY(1px) and a deeper shadow) as well as on hover — touch users get the same tactile confirmation as mouse users.

dos: Do use Counter Green for exactly one primary action per view.
Do give every interactive card and button a hover lift and a press response, on both mouse and touch.
Do widen line-height and add vertical padding on headings when rendering Hindi or Gujarati.
Do keep the disclaimer bar and fee-transparency language in warning/neutral tones, never recolored into the brand palette.
Do use the paper/white contrast to separate content surfaces from the page, rather than introducing a second neutral gray.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color competing with Counter Green for primary-action attention.
Don't flatten cards and buttons to a shadowless, borderless style — the tactile lift is a confirmed system trait.
Don't let a translated string change a component's box model — headings and buttons must absorb longer Hindi/Gujarati strings without breaking their grid.
Don't use pill radius on primary buttons or content cards — pill shape is reserved for badges, toggles, and a few signature chrome elements.
